ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
There are three great circles on a sphere that intersect each other in a right angle. Starting in point S a little bug moves along the great circles in the direction indicated. At crossings it turns alternately to the right or left. How many quarter circles does it crawl along until it is back in point S?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a sphere, on which three great circles that intersect pairwise perpendicularly are drawn; these intersection points form a structure similar to a spherical octahedron. Point S is at the intersection point on the right side of the sphere, and the starting arrow shows the bug crawling left from S along the front approximately horizontal great-circle arc. In the figure, subsequent direction arrows can also be seen: after reaching the next intersection point, it goes upward along the vertical great circle, then continues forward along the arcs on the left side and above. Then reason: The three mutually perpendicular great circles make the sphere's intersection points be regarded as the 6 vertices of an octahedron, and a segment of great-circle arc between every two adjacent intersection points is a quarter circle. Every time the bug reaches an intersection point it alternately turns right and left, so after starting from S and following the initial direction given in the figure, the subsequent route is uniquely determined. Tracking this alternating right-turn, left-turn route along the edges of the octahedron in sequence, it will first return to S after passing through 6 quarter-circle arcs. Therefore the number of quarter circles it crawls over is 6.

method.method_draft: Model the diagram as the spherical octahedron formed by three mutually perpendicular great circles. First read the image: S is the marked crossing on the right side, and the initial arrow shows the bug moving leftward along the front horizontal great-circle arc; the next visible arrows indicate that after the next crossing the path goes upward on the vertical great circle, then continues around the left/top arcs. From the text, use that every crossing is a right-angle intersection and the bug alternates right and left turns. Label the six crossings as the six vertices of an octahedron and each quarter-circle segment between crossings as one edge. Starting from S with the indicated outgoing edge, trace the unique edge chosen by alternating right/left at each vertex. Count one for each edge traversed. The traced cycle returns to S after 6 quarter-circle edges.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个球面，上面画出三条两两垂直相交的大圆；这些交点构成类似球面八面体的结构。点 S 在球的右侧交点处，起始箭头显示小虫从 S 沿前方近似水平的大圆弧向左爬。图中还可见后续方向箭头：到下一个交点后沿竖直大圆向上，再沿左侧和上方的圆弧继续前进。

再推理：三条互相垂直的大圆把球面交点看作八面体的 6 个顶点，每两个相邻交点之间的一段大圆弧就是一个四分之一圆。小虫每到一个交点就交替右转、左转，因此从 S 出发并按图中给定的初始方向后，之后的路线是唯一确定的。沿八面体边依次追踪这条交替右、左转的路线，会经过 6 条四分之一圆弧后第一次回到 S。因此它爬过的四分之一圆数量是 6。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the fact that three pairwise perpendicular great circles meet in six points and divide the sphere into quarter-circle arcs, forming the edge graph of an octahedron; turning right/left at a crossing means switching to the other great circle in the corresponding local direction.
